       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - ONLINE
*
* THE CICS ATTACHMENT NAMES CARDONLP ON THE DB2CONN.  ONE PLAN FOR
* THE WHOLE REGION.  PKLIST CARRIES BOTH COLLECTIONS BECAUSE THE
* PROGRAMS REACHED THROUGH THE ONLINE DISPATCHER RUN UNDER THE
* DISPATCHING TASK'S PLAN, WHICHEVER COLLECTION THEIR PACKAGE IS IN.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(CARDONLP) OWNER(CARDADM) QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) -
       PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*, PRTYCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(NO) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) CACHESIZE(2048) DEGREE(1) -
       DISCONNECT(EXPLICIT) NODEFER(PREPARE)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - NIGHTLY CYCLE
*
* RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) - THE CYCLE JOBS ARE LONG RUNNING AND RE-USING
* THE PACKAGE ALLOCATIONS ACROSS COMMITS SAVES A LARGE AMOUNT OF
* CATALOG TRAFFIC.
*
* PKLIST INCLUDES PRTYCOLL BECAUSE ONE OF THE STEPS IN THIS CYCLE
* DISPATCHES A TARGET WHOSE PACKAGE IS BOUND INTO THAT COLLECTION AND
* IT EXECUTES UNDER THIS PLAN.  WITHOUT THE ENTRY THE STEP FAILS
* SQLCODE -805 AT THE FIRST SQL IN THE DISPATCHED MODULE.  DO NOT
* REMOVE IT WHEN TIDYING THE PKLIST.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(CARDNITP) OWNER(CARDADM) QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) -
       PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*, PRTYCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(YES) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) CACHESIZE(0) DEGREE(1)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - BILLING
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(CARDBILP) OWNER(CARDADM) QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) -
       PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(YES) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) CACHESIZE(0) DEGREE(1)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - WEEKLY REFERENCE REBUILD
*
* VALIDATE(RUN) - THE REBUILD RUNS AGAINST WHATEVER IS THERE, AND HAS
* TO BIND CLEANLY IN THE DR SUBSYSTEM WHERE SOME OBJECTS ARE ABSENT.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(CARDREFP) OWNER(CARDADM) QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) -
       PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(YES) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(RUN) -
       EXPLAIN(NO) CACHESIZE(0) DEGREE(1)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* REPORT WHAT WAS BOUND
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  RUN PROGRAM(DSNTIAD) PLAN(DSNTIA13) -
      LIB('DSN.RUNLIB.LOAD')
  END

* GROUP LIST MAINTENANCE
*
* CARDLIST IS THE APPLICATION GROUP LIST NAMED ON GRPLIST IN THE SIT
* AFTER THE IBM SUPPLIED LISTS.  THE ORDER OF THE ADDS BELOW IS THE
* ORDER THE GROUPS ARE INSTALLED AT AN INITIAL START.
*

* WITH OPENTIME(STARTUP) ARE KNOWN BEFORE ANY PROGRAM CAN REFERENCE
* THEM.  PRTYGRP INSTALLS LAST - IT IS THE ONLY GROUP OWNED OUTSIDE
* CARD SYSTEMS AND IS THE ONE MOST OFTEN REINSTALLED ON ITS OWN.

  DELETE LIST(CARDLIST)

  ADD GROUP(CARDTDQ)  LIST(CARDLIST)
  ADD GROUP(CARDGRP)  LIST(CARDLIST)
  ADD GROUP(PRTYGRP)  LIST(CARDLIST)
*

*--------------------------------------------------------------------
  LIST LIST(CARDLIST) OBJECTS
